notes.title: Add to your wishlist now!
notes.content:
The release of the game is very soon! Now you can add the game to your wishlist, or contact me with discord for beta test!
If you want to get access to the game earlier, it's better to [url=https://discord.gg/n87Nwe4BwV]contact me[/url].

- What is it for?
- I don't have enough people to test the game, so I'm looking for them. To do this, you will need to play the game longer than usual and make special bug reports. You can find more information from me personally.

- How will it be? To do this, will need to download a separate game client?
- No, of course not! You will receive a key that will give you immediate access to the game.

- Does the key stay with the tester forever?
- Yes! However, if the tester does not meet the requirements, the key will be blocked and access to the game will closed until its release.

If you have any questions, you can ask me in [url=https://discord.gg/n87Nwe4BwV]Discord[/url].

Thank you and have a great day!
